description: This file defines the ModelPermGroup class, which models a group of permissions within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting permission join type, retrieving permissions, and evaluating permissions based on a context.

classes.name: ModelPermGroup
classes.description: Represents a permission group with a list of permissions and a join type ('AND' or 'OR') to evaluate permissions collectively.

methods.name: setJoinType
methods.description: Sets the type of join ('AND' or 'OR') used to evaluate permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions contained in this group.

methods.name: evalPermissions
methods.description: Evaluates the permissions in the context of the provided dispatch context and data context, returning success or error results based on the join logic.
